description_nl: Enable project .gitignore generation and merge using a universal base plus github/gitignore snapshots selected by project contents, including Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and Dotnet.

installer.notes: Detects project type, selects matching github/gitignore snapshots, and merges missing ignore patterns.

acceptance: Existing .gitignore is not replaced by default
suggested_when: Enable when repository ignore rules should be normalized independently of code tooling.
